# proj02
Template repository for Project 2, Stat 159/259 Fall 2025

Brief Objective of Project:
The goal of this project was to work on familiarizing ourselves with building an NLP pipeline. First, we are taking in raw text and converting it into structured data. Second, we do data analysis such as time series or frequency of words analysis. Then, we use LDA and BERTopic to find topics based on the words we gathered. Lastly, we ensure all of this is reproducible.
